---
title: "Related R packages"
---

These packages implement methods discussed in or closely related to the book.

| Package | Use |
|---|---|
| [glmnet](https://cran.r-project.org/package=glmnet) | Lasso and elastic-net regularized generalized linear models |
| [mda](https://cran.r-project.org/package=mda) | Flexible and mixture discriminant analysis |
| [lars](https://cran.r-project.org/package=lars) | Efficient least-angle regression and lasso paths |
| [gbm](https://cran.r-project.org/package=gbm) | Gradient boosting |
| [princurve](https://cran.r-project.org/package=princurve) | Principal curves |
| [bootstrap](https://cran.r-project.org/package=bootstrap) | Bootstrap and cross-validation routines |

Package links should be reviewed periodically because software availability changes independently of the book.
